title.narrative: Strengthened capacity of constituents for developing inclusive, sustainable and resilient skills and lifelong learning systems

description.narrative: The ILO has been supporting the ILO constituents in strengthening TVET (Technical and Vocational Education and Training) system to improve the match between skills supply and market demand with a complete package of support from labour market analysis, competency-based approach to training, upgrading of skills through training, career orientation and post-training employment support. ILO interventions support constituents in developing inclusive, market responsive and resilient skills systems to meet changing labour market needs in the country. This biennium, the ILO is focusing on strengthening the skills forecasting system and developing the capacity of the Association of Lebanese Association to collect regular information on the skills needs of the priority sector. In addition to establishing a model for Public-Private partnerships to strengthen skills governance, co-financing, market-responsive skills delivery and post-training support services. Within the framework of the ILO-ESCWA partnership on skills and social justice, the two agencies plan to support the development of a national observatory on skills in Lebanon that builds on skills monitor and is complemented with supply-side information, to support analysis, measurement of mismatch and the eventual development of effective policy measures.
